questions.question: Which Pokémon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Pikachu has been Ash's partner since the very first episode.

questions.question: Which Pokémon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: In the show Jigglypuff gets cross when its audience falls asleep and scribbles on their faces.

questions.question: Which Pokémon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: When Psyduck's headache gets bad enough, it unleashes powerful psychic attacks.

questions.question: Which Pokémon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The flame on Charmander's tail burns brightly when it is healthy.

questions.question: What type of Pokémon is Squirtle?
questions.explanation: Squirtle is one of the three starter Pokémon in Pokémon Red and Blue.

questions.question: Which Pokémon does Magikarp evolve into?
questions.explanation: Weak, splashing Magikarp grows into the fearsome Gyarados.

questions.question: What is the name of the gadget that tells Ash all about each Pokémon he meets?
questions.explanation: Professor Oak gives Ash his Pokédex in the very first episode.

questions.question: Which of Eevee's evolutions is a Fire type?
questions.explanation: Eevee becomes Flareon when it is given a Fire Stone.

questions.question: Which type of move is super effective against Fire-type Pokémon?
questions.explanation: Water puts out fire, so Water moves do double damage.

questions.question: Which Pokémon travels with Jessie and James in Team Rocket?
questions.explanation: Team Rocket's Meowth taught himself to walk on two legs and talk like a human.

questions.question: What is the name of Ash's rival in the first Pokémon series?
questions.explanation: Gary is Professor Oak's grandson.

questions.question: Which Pokémon is number 001 in the National Pokédex?
questions.explanation: Bulbasaur is the Grass and Poison starter from the Kanto region.

questions.question: What colour is a shiny Charizard?
questions.explanation: Shiny Pokémon are rare colour versions, and since Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire a shiny Charizard has been black instead of orange.

questions.question: Mewtwo was created by scientists from the genes of which Pokémon?
questions.explanation: In Pokémon Red and Blue, old diaries in the Pokémon Mansion on Cinnabar Island tell how Mewtwo was made.

questions.question: In the show, which town does Ash come from?
questions.explanation: Pallet Town is also where you start your adventure in Pokémon Red and Blue.

questions.question: Which Pokémon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Haunter evolves into Gengar when it is traded.

questions.question: Which Pokémon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Kadabra holds one spoon, and its evolution Alakazam holds two.

questions.question: Which Pokémon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Brock, the Pewter City Gym Leader, relies on his giant rock snake.

questions.question: In which year were the first Pokémon games, Red and Green, released in Japan?
questions.explanation: They reached the UK as Pokémon Red and Blue in 1999.

questions.question: How many Pokémon were in the original Red and Blue Pokédex?
questions.explanation: Mew was the secret extra, number 151.

questions.question: Which company develops the main series of Pokémon games?
questions.explanation: Pokémon's creator Satoshi Tajiri dreamed it up from his childhood love of collecting bugs.

questions.question: Which Pokémon type was added in Pokémon X and Y?
questions.explanation: Fairy-type Pokémon are completely immune to Dragon moves.

questions.question: Who is the Gym Leader of Cerulean City?
questions.explanation: Misty specialises in Water-type Pokémon.

questions.question: Which Pokémon does Machoke evolve into when it is traded?
questions.explanation: Machamp has four arms.

questions.question: Which Legendary bird is an Ice and Flying type?
questions.explanation: Zapdos and Moltres complete the trio of Legendary birds.

questions.question: In which year was Pokémon Go released?
questions.explanation: It was made by Niantic.

questions.question: Which region of Pokémon Sword and Shield is based on Great Britain?
questions.explanation: Its Gym battles are held in huge football-style stadiums.

questions.question: In the anime, who does Ash beat in the final to become World Champion?
questions.explanation: Leon was the long-unbeaten Champion of the Galar region.

questions.question: Which Legendary Pokémon is on the box of Pokémon Silver?
questions.explanation: Ho-Oh is on the box of Pokémon Gold.

questions.question: What is Ash's surname in the English version of the anime?
questions.explanation: In Japan he is called Satoshi, after the creator of Pokémon.
